C-WINDOWS-PREF-FIXTURES.Name: Portable privacy fixture verification on Windows
C-WINDOWS-PREF-FIXTURES.Summary: Repair the two failures observed in the Windows job of run 39250822379 after the approved privacy cleanup: native path separators differ from manifest paths, and autocrlf changes the manifest and byte-hashed JSON examples.
C-WINDOWS-PREF-FIXTURES.ApprovalBasis: Owner approved finishing and sequentially integrating desktop fixes and required complete safety verification. This bounded CI repair preserves the newly approved publication boundary and fixture contents.

Goals.Goal: Verify the same six synthetic examples and exact Git bytes on every host, with portable manifest paths and newline parsing.

Constraints.Constraint: No relaxed hashes, omitted files, threshold changes, private data reintroduction or runtime behavior change. Preserve existing approved plans and frozen provenance.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No release, account operation, broad GRACE reconciliation or changes to preference semantics.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Privacy tests pass; seven pinned fixture/manifest files retain exact Git bytes under core.autocrlf=true; final Windows CI passes.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-046 test configuration; V-M-005 and V-M-046 fixture/publication evidence.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Original failed Windows job, portable local fixture checks, forced-autocrlf checkout byte comparison and fresh multi-platform CI.
